_note: Words of the Trio shortcut. Placeholders {C} {P} {T} {R} {L} are wired by src/build_trio.py — keep them.
name: Trio
comment: Trio — ChatGPT and Claude answer separately, a third AI from another company names only what both missed. Then Claude compares all three answers and writes the final one: matched independently / did not match / what to check yourself. The third voice works on FREE keys — NVIDIA (Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek), Google AI Studio (Gemini), OpenRouter or Groq, any number of them — kept in iCloud Drive → Shortcuts → poly-key.txt, one per line, never inside this shortcut, so sharing the shortcut never shares a key. Trio tries every key and every free model until one answers. ChatGPT: Start new chat ON, Continuous OFF. You may add your own paid key too (xAI, DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI) — you pay your provider directly; nothing passes through us.
ask.question: What do you want to ask the trio?
ask.key:
iPhone 15 Pro or newer? You don't need a key: tap Cancel and install Trio without a key (link on the Trio page).

Next, iPhone will ask for permission several times: tap «Always Allow» each time, right away.

Trio asks a third AI, and it needs a free key (a long password you get once, no card). Easiest, about a minute, no SMS: open Safari, go to aistudio.google.com/apikey, sign in with Google, tap «Create API key», copy it, come back and paste it here.

Other free options: Groq (console.groq.com/keys), NVIDIA (build.nvidia.com/settings/api-keys, asks an SMS code), OpenRouter (openrouter.ai/keys). Your own paid key works too; you pay your provider directly.
Several keys: one per line, saved once in iCloud Drive → Shortcuts → poly-key.txt.
notify.start: 🎻 Trio [1/4]: ChatGPT is answering. About 90 seconds — don't touch the phone.
notify.step2: [2/4] Claude answers on its own, without seeing ChatGPT's answer…
notify.step3: [3/4] A third AI looks for what both missed… Claude's answer is now in the clipboard.
notify.summary: [4/4] Claude is comparing the three answers and writing the final one…
notify.compare_retry: The comparison did not come — asking once more with a shorter text…
notify.done: ✅ Trio is done. The full result is in the clipboard.
why.billing: this key has no credit left or is no longer valid (402); a free key from another account or provider works
why.key: the key is invalid or deleted (401)
why.limit: free limit reached (429) — per minute or for today
why.model: the model is gone or renamed (404)
why.other: no answer (no internet, or the provider refused)
error.all:
⚠️ The third AI is silent this time; Claude's checked answer above is complete. What each said:{L}

Busy or limit: run Trio again in a minute or tomorrow. A key with no credit or no longer valid: open poly-key.txt (Files → iCloud Drive → Shortcuts) and replace that line with a new free key, for example from openrouter.ai/keys.
error.nokeys: ⚠️ No valid key in poly-key.txt. Open the file (Files → iCloud Drive → Shortcuts), replace the wrong line with a valid key, and run Trio again. Claude's answer above is complete.
nokey.comment: Trio without a key — ChatGPT and Claude answer separately, and the third voice is Apple Intelligence (the «Use Model» action, on an iPhone with Apple Intelligence, iOS 26 or later): no key to get. If a key is saved in iCloud Drive → Shortcuts → poly-key.txt, the third voice uses it instead, exactly as the key-based Trio does. Then Claude compares all three answers and writes the final one: matched independently / did not match / what to check yourself. ChatGPT: Start new chat ON, Continuous OFF.
nokey.notify.step3: [3/4] Apple Intelligence looks for what both missed… Claude's answer is now in the clipboard.
notify.empty_question: No question, so nothing was sent. Run Trio again and type your question.
notify.empty_key: No key, so Trio stopped. Run it again and paste one key.
notify.third_silent: The third AI was silent; Claude's answer is complete.
nokey.no_ai: This iPhone cannot use Apple Intelligence. Install the Trio version that uses a free provider key: polyhelper.ai/duo/. Claude's answer above is complete.
error.compare:
⚠️ Claude's comparison did not come. Claude's own answer, written before it saw ChatGPT's:

{C}
